{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted blazer, single-breasted, hip length, deep burgundy #5E1F2D, textured wool crepe
Silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a soft bow neckline, tucked in, cream #F1E6D6, matte satin
Trousers, high-waisted, straight leg, full length to the ankle, charcoal #33343A, fine wool twill
Ankle boots, low block heel, almond toe, black #1C1A1B, smooth leather
Wool coat, tailored, knee length, midnight navy #1F2A44, brushed wool
Clutch, structured, small, black #1C1A1B, leather
Drop earrings, small, antique gold #B08D57, metal
Thin leather belt, black #1C1A1B, with a small gold buckle

This outfit sits right in the neat band for a social evening: a textured jacket, a refined blouse, trousers and ankle boots, so it looks polished without being overdressed for the theatre. The burgundy blazer and cream blouse stand out against her dark hair and soft, light skin, while the blue-grey of her eyes is picked up by the navy coat and the charcoal trousers. The matte fabrics and gold accents hold up well under the warm artificial light of the theatre. The coat covers the autumn chill on the way in and comes off easily in the hall."}
